stem: A development team wants to deploy an AI agent in Microsoft Foundry using a custom framework and custom business logic packaged in a container, with Foundry managing endpoint scaling and identity. Which agent type in Foundry Agent Service should the team select?
explanation: Hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service provide the highest degree of developer control by allowing teams to bring their own code and custom frameworks packaged as a container, while Foundry manages the runtime endpoint, scaling, and Microsoft Entra identity integration.

distractorNotes.a: Prompt agents are defined entirely through configuration (instructions, model, and tools) and run on a fully managed runtime without custom container deployment.
distractorNotes.c: The Responses API is used when calling Foundry models and tools directly from agents hosted entirely outside of Foundry resources.
distractorNotes.d: Voice-based prompt agents are managed agents designed for real-time, spoken audio interactions connecting over WebSockets.

sourceNote: Foundry Agent Service agent types - hosted agents for custom containers and frameworks
